title: Biscuit SMP
description: A small QoL modpack intended for use on Biscuit SMP. Not much use for singleplayer.
body:
Biscuit SMP is a small, lightweight quality-of-life modpack built specifically for the Biscuit SMP server hosted by corybiscuit. It’s designed to keep the gameplay experience feeling close to vanilla while adding subtle improvements that make day-to-day survival, building, and exploration smoother, cleaner, and more enjoyable.

This modpack is a slightly modified version of [_Fabulously Optimized_](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized).
